field.odor_units: dimensionless, summed Gaussian fields; fixed c/(1+c) observation transform
field.sugar_units: dimensionless contact intensity in [0,1]; maximum over touched sources
field.geometry: Virtual upright closed cylinders from source z to z+height; contact uses six tarsus5 body-frame origins, not collision manifolds
field.scope: Synthetic sensor/task interface. No fluid dynamics, identified receptor neurons, ingestion, reward update or learned behavior.
